progress_events.note: Source-only V075A finished in scoped commit; local fake proof green. Capture absence and no live native read are explicitly recorded; shared export remains a separate owner step.

changes.result: Scoped commit e13487a6 adds crates/herder/src/adapters/zcode/transcript.rs and acceptance/native/zcode/transcript-legacy.json. Reader uses the exact existing session with runtimePolicy=existing-only and messageLimit=200, verifies returned session ID, preserves typed raw parts/native type/index and legacy plain user content via source_field=content, and binds page cursors to principal plus a snapshot hash over node/instance/session and full response. Local pages are explicitly slices of the bounded native batch; truncation is independent and conservatively true at the 200-message cap or when native payload says truncated. Fake-source harness tests: 3/3 passed; shared domain transcript tests: 8/8 passed; `rustfmt +stable --check`, JSON parse and diff checks passed. V072B records no native ZCode transcript capture, so the acceptance fixture honestly reuses its synthetic legacy DTO shape; no live read, create, send or model action was performed. Shared lib/Cargo export was not changed; runtime/consumer readback is not claimed.

progress_events.note: Rounded elapsed time up to 16 minutes from recorded leaf start and live clock.
